answer: Require every identity to rent its own safe-deposit box at the harbor bank, opened with a unique ivory-handled key tied to one verified person. Rent is $22 per box per epoch, plus a $4 surcharge for each extra box under the same name, so ten fake identities cost $400 per epoch and the bill grows linearly with every new fake. When a gale of new signups hits, the rising fees make mass forgery unprofitable while honest agents pay only one small rent.
